text: Ethics in AI is an important topic today. As artificial intelligence becomes part of our daily lives, we must think about how it affects people. One major concern is bias. AI systems can learn unfair patterns from data, which may lead to discrimination against certain groups. To prevent this, fairness must be a priority when designing these systems. Privacy is another key issue, because AI often collects and uses personal information. Companies should protect user data and be transparent about how it is used. Finally, responsible AI development means involving diverse voices, testing systems carefully, and making sure decisions are open to public discussion. Only in this way can we build technology that benefits everyone fairly.
